Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You measure the gap in a glance and let your stride become a leap.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
A visible unoccupied landing within 3 squares
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Choose a landing within the rolled distance. If none is safe, remain at the origin. This crosses gaps, not walls; it is not flight. Ordinary jumping remains available without this card.

Weak
Jump up to 1 square.
Standard
Jump up to 2 squares.
Strong
Jump up to 3 squares.
